children: RNS Number : 4174W  Games Workshop Group PLC  25 September 2026

The Company confirms that a new block admission application (the “New Block Admission Application”) has been made to the London Stock Exchange for 15,000 ordinary shares of 5p each in the capital of the Company (the “New Ordinary Shares”) to be admitted to trading on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange.
The New Ordinary Shares will, upon issue, rank equally with all other ordinary shares of the Company that are in issue.

The New Ordinary Shares will be issued by the Company from time to time under the terms of the Games Workshop Group 2025 Sharesave Plan (formerly known as the Games Workshop Group 2015 Sharesave Plan) (the “Plan”).
It is anticipated that the New Ordinary Shares will be admitted on 29 September 2026.
The New Block Admission Application is in addition to the Company's existing block admission (the “Existing Block Admission”) for the Plan, last increased on 6 September 2022.
